rationale: Volume-confirmed momentum with a binary intraday gate. The continuous intraday position from the parent is replaced by a binary indicator (1 if close is above midpoint, -1 if below) to reduce noise and improve MI and RankIC stability while preserving the core economic mechanism of volume-confirmed momentum gated by intraday price position.
filter: volume > 0 AND not is_suspend AND close < high_limit AND close > low_limit
